preconditions.description: Garden dimensions n and m are within bounds, and total squares do not exceed 200.
The number of important squares k is at least 1 and at most 7 (or total squares if fewer).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= val <= 1000 for row in grid for val in row)
preconditions.description: Every flower count aij in the n x m grid is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(important_coords) == k and all(1 <= r <= n and 1 <= c <= m for r, c in important_coords)
preconditions.description: There are exactly k important square coordinates, each within the grid bounds.
All k important squares have distinct coordinates.

postconditions.description: The output plan is a valid n x m grid of 'X' and '.' characters where all important squares are covered with 'X' and all 'X' squares form a single connected component.

postconditions.expression: total_cost == sum(grid[r-1][c-1] for r, c in important_coords) + sum(grid[r-1][c-1] for r, c in covered_non_important(plan, n, m, important_coords))
postconditions.description: The printed integer total_cost equals the sum of flowers in all concrete-covered squares (important plus any additional squares needed for connectivity).
The total_cost is the minimum possible sum of flowers among all valid plans that connect all important squares.
